caption:
Starship Flight 14 is on the launch pad at Starbase, Texas, hours before liftoff. This is the most powerful rocket ever built.

SpaceX has been flying Starship since 2023, learning something new with every test. The rocket produces more thrust at liftoff than any other in history and is built to eventually carry people and cargo to the Moon and Mars. There is no catch attempt for the booster or ship on this flight, so both pieces will come down in the ocean. Every launch adds data toward making the whole thing fully reusable.

If you have never seen it up close on the pad, the scale is hard to believe.
